annotations.title: Hyperliquid tracked positions: the liquidation price map of the large accounts per coin, against the LiqMap model

description: Call this when the user asks where Hyperliquid whales would be liquidated, how much tracked notional sits at each price, how the large accounts lean on a coin, or how their liquidation prices compare with the LiqMap model. The universe is every account whose open perpetual positions add up to a large sum, found in the venue's public fill record, together with the largest accounts by equity on its public leaderboard; positions are read on the main dex and on the builder-deployed dexes (markets such as xyz:NVDA), the largest accounts every 5 minutes, the others every 20 to 25 minutes (measured on 24 November 2026; the venue's request limit sets the pace); an account that trades a net $1,000,000 of a single coin between two readings is read at once; the levels are their own liquidation prices bucketed around the mark. hours returns the hourly archive of level totals. Without detail, the bands within 25% of the mark on either side (at least the nearest 30 per side) and at most the newest 168 hours; pass detail "compact" for a shorter page (10%, 48 hours) or "full" for every band.

coin.description: Coin as Hyperliquid names it, e.g. BTC, kPEPE, xyz:NVDA (default BTC; a builder-deployed market carries its dex in front; any case)

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.
